scope: Finite retained-group assembly and R5-allocation/P3-claim/R3-join transaction contract only. No P3 payload movement, R2 candidate, R1 request, descriptor write, metadata publication, storage macro, timing, PPA, model/GPU, or new A4 DSE claim.

anchor.p3_reservation_owner_meaning: single-packer-local reservation label only; not an R1 request ID, external address, scheduler decision, or authority owner

child.name: route_a_admission_publication_ingress_adapter
owns: one finite immutable group assembly association
one-shot relay of exact R6 authority/context facts to R3

carriers.rule: accept the two facts atomically; only hot-to-pending RETAIN is legal
issue exactly once only after every ordinal 0..valid_records-1 is present
accept exactly one matching response; a mismatch/fault cannot claim P3
issue once after matching R5 allocation; owner is the anchor-local reservation value 0
acknowledge exactly one matching claim before any relay to R3
relay every exact stored ordinal once after claim acknowledgement; never synthesize a span
carriers.authority_effect: the original R6 hot_to_pending transition is relayed without duplication or change

state_and_order: first accepted member fixes group tag, layer, kv_head, and valid-record count
each ordinal is unique and must be less than valid_records; non-contiguous entry_id values are legal and retained verbatim
the group is complete only when every ordinal in 0..valid_records-1 is present
R5 allocation precedes P3 claim; P3 claim acknowledgement precedes every R3 member join
each stored member and its matching R6 authority event relay exactly once
stall may delay a carrier but cannot mutate a held member, alter disposition, omit a member, or transfer authority
fault_and_reset: an R5 allocation mismatch, R3 claim mismatch, or destructive reset discards only the transient builder association and emits no P3 publication or authority transition
after reset, stale allocation/claim responses cannot match a new group association
a partially assembled group has no P3 claim, no R1 work, no visible descriptor, and no packed authority

required_follow_on.requires: Add the reviewed protocol-only child and wire existing R6/R5/R3 carriers through it; use the frozen logical 64-member bound but claim no physical queue depth.
required_follow_on.not_authorized: Do not add payload transfer, P3 functional backing, R2/R1 work, descriptor terminal, M2 member result, metadata_publish_commit, or source-service behavior.
